evidence.notes: Typed String query and binds with SYSTEM_MODE return matching rows in deployable Apex test context.
Typed count query and binds with SYSTEM_MODE return the matching count in deployable Apex test context.
Typed query and binds with SYSTEM_MODE produce a matching QueryLocator in deployable Apex test context.

source.content: @isTest private class DataDatabaseQueryLocatorAccessSystemModeRuntimeTest { @isTest static void bindQueriesRunInSystemMode() { insert new List<Account>{new Account(Name = 'Query-One'), new Account(Name = 'Query-Two')}; String queryText = 'SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Name = :wanted'; Map<String,Object> binds = new Map<String,Object>{'wanted' => 'Query-One'}; System.assertEquals(1, Database.queryWithBinds(queryText, binds, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE).size()); System.assertEquals(1, Database.countQueryWithBinds('SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = :wanted', binds, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE)); Database.QueryLocator locator = Database.getQueryLocatorWithBinds(queryText, binds, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); Object iterator = locator.iterator(); System.assert(iterator.hasNext()); System.assertEquals('Query-One', ((Account)iterator.next()).Name); System.assert(!iterator.hasNext()); } }
